description: This file contains PHP classes that implement compilation logic for Smarty template functions, including classes for starting and closing template functions, with methods that generate PHP code for these template constructs.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Function
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling the {function} tag in Smarty templates, generating PHP code that defines a new template function.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Functionclose
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling the {/function} closing tag, finalizing the generated PHP code for the template function.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Main method for compiling the {function} or {/function} tags, which generates PHP code for defining or closing a Smarty template function.

methods.name: removeNocache
methods.description: Helper method to strip nocache-related code blocks from generated PHP code during compilation.
